# ProfileFPS

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Other](Language-Features-Other)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ProfileFPS:Void enable:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enable` | In | Int32 | required | 1 to print the report, 0 to stop printing it. |

## Description

Turns the report on or off that prints the frames per second and the timers of the runtime once a second, on the standard error output, like setting the environment variable `BLITZLLVM_PROFILE_FPS` to `1` or `0` (which only decides how the program starts). The timers must be running, see [ProfileEnable](ProfileEnable). Without `--profile` this command does nothing.

## Differences

* This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 64, 64, 0, 2
ProfileFPS 1
Local start = MilliSecs()
While MilliSecs() - start < 2500
	Cls
	Flip
Wend
ProfileFPS 0
```
